stem: A tow truck travels at a speed of at least 25 miles per hour but no more than 45 miles per hour for a section of a road. Which inequality represents this situation, where x is the speed of the tow truck, in miles per hour, on this section of the road?

answerOptions.content: 25≤x≤45

rationale:
Choice C is correct. It's given that a tow truck travels at a speed of at least 25 miles per hour but no more than 45 miles per hour. It's also given that x represents the speed of the tow truck, in miles per hour. At least 25 miles per hour means x≥25, and no more than 45 miles per hour means x≤45. Therefore, the inequality that represents this situation is 25≤x≤45.
